{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Trump Administration has completely failed in its response to the opioid epidemic, leaving millions of families desperate for help.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will make medication-assisted treatment available to all who need it.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will require publicly supported health clinics to offer medication-assisted treatment for opioid addiction and approved treatments for other substance use disorders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe over-prescribing must be stopped while improving access to effective and needed pain management.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support expanded access to mental health and substance use disorder care in prisons and for returning citizens.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure no one is incarcerated solely for drug use.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support increased use of drug courts, harm reduction interventions, and treatment diversion programs for those struggling with substance use disorders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Incarcerated people suffer from serious mental health and substance use disorders at higher rates than the general population.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
